title: Darrowshire: Lost and Remembered
summary: Pamela Redpath's quest revisits a village destroyed by the Scourge and the Battle of Darrowshire.
opening: Darrowshire survives in memory after its fall. Pamela's search turns scattered accounts into a journey through what happened there.
reviewNote: Primary quest text for Pamela Redpath, Marauders of Darrowshire, and Battle of Darrowshire still needs capture. The later quest does not redate the original fall.
